name: John Cockerill India Ltd.
summary: John Cockerill India Ltd. specializes in the fabrication and deployment of cold rolling mill systems. The company supplies a broad spectrum of specialized equipment to both ferrous and non-ferrous industries worldwide. Its product offerings encompass processing lines, galvanizing lines, color coating lines, tension leveling lines, skin pass mills, acid regeneration plants, wet flux lines, pickling lines, and other supplementary steel treatment machinery. The enterprise was founded on May 28, 1986, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Mumbai, India.
